ValidationRule.description: The Merchant Checklist Acknowledged field must be TRUE before the Opportunity Stage can be marked as Funded on WC and Broker WC Opportunities
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: ISCHANGED(StageName) && ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Funded') && ((RecordType.Name = 'Broker WC Oppty' || RecordType.Name = 'Broker FRPSA') || (RecordType.Name = 'Working Capital Oppty' || RecordType.Name = 'FRPSA')) && (ISPICKVAL(Type,'NEW')|| ((ISPICKVAL(Type,'RENEWAL') || ISPICKVAL(Type,'CONCURRENT') || ISPICKVAL(Type,'RENEWAL CONCURRENT'))&& CONTAINS(Lender_Account__r.Name,'National Funding'))) && Lender_Account__r.Name <> 'Quick Bridge Funding' && Lender_Account__r.Name <> 'Advance Me, Inc (Merchant)' && Lender_Account__r.Name <> 'Business Financial Services' && Lender_Account__r.Name <> 'Merchant Cash & Capital' && Lender_Account__r.Name <> 'LoanMe' && Lender_Account__r.Name <> 'Expansion Capital Group' && Lender_Account__r.Name <> 'Elevate Funding, LLC' && NOT(CONTAINS(Lender_Account__r.Name,'New Logic')) && Merchant_Checklist_Acknowledged__c = FALSE
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The Merchant Checklist must be acknowledged before the Opportunity can be marked as 'Funded'
